blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: As generative models tackle larger and more complex datasets, learned codecs enable efficient generation through compact latent representations, but may lose details and cannot guarantee exact preservation of given conditions. Generating directly in the original data space avoids errors introduced by the codec. Recent advances in image generation demonstrate that pixel diffusion can produce high-quality samples at practical computational costs. Inspired by these advances, we conduct a preliminary study of pixel diffusion, demonstrating its potential for adaptation to motion generation. Building on these findings, we present RawMo, a framework that brings text-to-motion generation to raw motion space. Our Motion Diffusion Transformer (MiT) models local skeletal structures and whole-body dynamics, while refining motion across frames to improve temporal consistency. Working directly in raw motion space further allows our high-noise text-motion alignment loss (HiNCE) to improve text consistency without intermediate motion decoding. RawMo supports multiple motion-conditioning tasks with a single conditional model while preserving given motion conditions exactly. Experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML show the best text alignment among compared methods and competitive motion quality, with ablations confirming the benefits of MiT and HiNCE.
blocks.zh: 由于基因模型处理的是更大和更复杂的数据集,所学的编码器通过紧凑的潜在表示可以有效生成,但可能失去细节,无法保证确切保存特定条件。 直接在原始数据空间中生成,可以避免解码器引入的错误. 图像生成的最新进展表明,像素扩散能够以实际的计算成本产生出高质量的样本. 受这些进步的启发,我们对像素扩散进行了初步研究,展示了其适应运动生成的潜力. 基于这些发现,我们提出了RawMo,一个将文字到动作生成带入原始运动空间的框架. 我们的运动分化变形器(Mition Diffusion Transformer (MIT)) 模拟了局部的骨骼结构和全身动力学,同时精炼了跨帧运动来提高时间一致性. 直接在原始运动空间中工作,进一步使我们的高噪音文本-运动对齐损失(HinCE)在不进行中间运动解码的情况下提高文本的一致性. RawMo支持多个具有单一条件模型的动作调节任务,同时准确保留给定的运动条件. 关于HumanML3D和KIT-ML的实验显示比较方法和竞相运动质量之间的最优文本相接,并有活化证实MiT和HINCE的好处.

blocks.en: Text-to-motion generation produces 3D human motion sequences from natural-language descriptions. The task has broad applications in character animation, games, and virtual environments, where natural and diverse movements are essential. Paired text-motion datasets [ 9 , 27 ] have supported progress in learning the relationship between language and movement. Early diffusion models generate motion through iterative denoising of full motion sequences [ 32 ] , but repeated processing can incur substantial sampling costs [ 1 ] . To reduce the computational burden, many approaches move generation into compact learned representations, using either continuous latent spaces or discrete motion codes [ 1 , 45 , 8 ] . Generation in these compact spaces has advanced efficiency while achieving improvements in motion quality and text consistency.
blocks.zh: 文本到运动生成从自然语言描述产生出3D人类运动序列. 这项任务在人物动画,游戏,以及虚拟环境中有着广泛的应用,其中自然而多样的运动是必不可少的. Paired text-motion data sets [9, 27] 支持在学习语言与运动的关系方面取得进展. 早期扩散模型通过迭代去除全运动序列来产生运动 [32],但重复处理可能会产生巨大的采样成本 [1]. 为了减轻计算负担,许多方法将生成转化为精密的已学到的表示,使用连续潜在空间或离散运动代码[1、45、8]。 这些紧凑空间的生成提高了效率,同时提高了运动质量和文本的一致性.

blocks.en: As generative models tackle larger and more complex data, learned latent spaces offer compact representations that reduce computation. An encoder compresses data into latent codes, and a decoder converts generated latent codes back into data samples. However, details can be lost during encoding and decoding, and latent-space generation alone is unable to guarantee exact preservation of given conditions. Recent work on pixel diffusion in the image domain demonstrates that direct data-space generation can achieve high quality at practical computational costs [ 18 , 40 ] . We explore this direction in the motion domain, where body regions and frame order can provide the basis for organizing local motion features and modeling temporal changes. Our goal is to use these known body and time relationships to model motion directly, instead of learning a separate compressed representation. Fig. 2 (a) illustrates our motivation for returning to raw motion: (i) avoiding errors introduced by a learned motion codec through direct generation and (ii) preserving given motion conditions exactly rather than matching them only approximately.
blocks.zh: 随着基因模型处理更大和更复杂的数据,所学的潜在空间提供了紧凑的表述,减少了计算。 一个编码器将数据压缩成潜在代码,一个解码器将生成的潜在代码转换回数据样本. 然而,在编码和解码过程中可能会丢失细节,仅凭潜在的空间生成无法保证特定条件的确切保存. 最近关于图像域像素扩散的研究表明,直接的数据-空间生成能够以实际的计算成本达到高质量[18,40]. 我们在运动领域探索这个方向,身体区域和帧顺序可以提供组织局部运动特征和模拟时间变化的基础. 我们的目标是利用这些已知的身体和时间关系来直接模拟运动,而不是学习单独的压缩表现. 图2(a)说明了我们恢复原始运动的动机:(一) 通过直接生成避免一个已学到的可编码运动引起的错误;(二) 保持特定运动条件的准确性,而不是仅仅大致匹配这些条件。

blocks.en: JiT [ 18 ] highlights that a denoising network can predict in one space while its loss is computed in another through output conversion. Inspired by this idea, we conduct a preliminary study comparing prediction targets and loss spaces using a plain JiT-style Transformer over raw motion patches. Consistent with JiT’s image experiments, clean-motion prediction with a flow-velocity loss gives the lowest FID among the tested combinations, supporting the feasibility of extending pixel-diffusion principles to motion generation. Section 3 presents the complete study.
blocks.zh: JiT [18]强调,一个去诺网络可以在一个空间中预测,而其损失则通过输出转换在另一个空间中计算出. 受这个想法的启发,我们进行了一项初步研究,比较预测目标与损失空间,使用平坦的JiT式变形器来比起原始的运动补丁. 与JiT的图像实验一致,流速损失的清洁运动预测在被测试的组合中给予最低的FID,支持将像素分流原理延伸至运动生成的可行性. 第3节介绍了完整的研究。

blocks.en: Building on these findings, we bring text-to-motion generation back to raw motion with RawMo . Adapting pixel diffusion to motion requires modeling body-part relationships and coordinated movement. Our Motion Diffusion Transformer (MiT) extends PixelDiT’s dual-level design [ 40 ] to model skeletal structures and whole-body dynamics, with a refinement head that promotes temporal continuity. To strengthen text alignment, we pretrain motion and text encoders on paired training data to establish a shared embedding space for measuring text-motion consistency. During RawMo training, our high-noise text-motion alignment loss (HiNCE) uses these frozen pretrained encoders to supervise clean-motion predictions at high-noise timesteps, guiding the model toward the described action in the early denoising steps. Fig. 2 (b) illustrates how MiT and HiNCE address motion structure and text alignment.
blocks.zh: 以这些发现为基础,我们把文字到动作的生成带回与RawMo的生动. 使像素扩散适应运动需要模拟体段关系和协调运动. 我们的运动扩散变换器(Mition Difusion Transformer (MIT)) 扩展了PixelDiT的双层设计[40],以模型化骨骼结构和全身动力学,并有一个能促进时间连续性的完善头. 为加强文本的对齐,我们在配对培训数据上预选了运动和文本编码器,以建立一个共享的嵌入空间来测量文本-运动的一致性. 在RawMo训练期间,我们的高噪音文本-运动对齐损失(HinCE)使用这些被冻结的事先训练的编码器来监督高噪音时段的清洁运动预测,指导模型在早期去诺步骤中向描述的行动. 图2(b)说明了MiT和HINCE如何处理运动结构和文本的对齐。

blocks.en: RawMo supports multiple motion-conditioning tasks with a single model, preserving given motion conditions exactly while generating the remaining motion. Comparisons on HumanML3D [ 9 ] and KIT-ML [ 27 ] assess motion quality, text consistency, and motion-conditioning performance. Fig. 1 shows HumanML3D results. RawMo achieves the strongest text alignment among compared methods and zero control error in motion-conditioned generation; ablations reveal how motion structure and supervision timing shape the balance between motion quality and text consistency.
blocks.zh: RawMo支持使用单一模型的多个运动调节任务,在生成剩余运动的同时,精确地保留给定的运动条件. HumanML3D[9]和KIT-ML[27]的比较评估了运动质量,文本一致性,以及运动调节性能. 图一显示HumanML3D结果. 原始内容 Mo在相比较方法之间实现最强的文本对接,在运动条件生成时实现零控制出错;活化会揭示运动结构和监督时间如何塑造运动质量和文本一致性之间的平衡.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We conduct a study demonstrating the feasibility of adapting pixel-diffusion principles to motion generation; the study identifies clean-motion prediction with a flow-velocity objective as an effective combination. • We propose RawMo, which brings text-to-motion generation back to raw motion; MiT models body and time structure, while HiNCE provides semantic supervision at high-noise timesteps. • Experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML demonstrate RawMo’s superior generation performance, while a single RawMo model supports multiple motion-conditioning tasks with exact preservation of given motion conditions.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Pixel-space image diffusion
blocks.zh: 2.1 像素空间图像传播

blocks.en: Pixel-space diffusion generates images directly without a learned codec. Early diffusion models performed iterative denoising in pixel space, but processing high-resolution images incurred substantial computational costs [ 11 , 5 ] . Latent diffusion reduced these costs by moving denoising into compressed representations, introducing dependence on a learned encoder and decoder [ 29 ] . Recent work revisits pixel-space generation through suitable prediction targets, loss spaces, and efficient architectures [ 18 , 40 , 2 ] . JiT [ 18 ] separates prediction targets from loss spaces, showing that clean-image prediction with a velocity-space objective enables plain Transformers to model high-dimensional pixel patches. Architectural developments further separate global modeling from local detail synthesis [ 40 , 2 ] . PixelDiT [ 40 ] combines patch-level semantic modeling with Pixel Transformer (PiT) blocks for fine-grained pixel updates, while complementary designs use lightweight local refinement [ 2 ] . These developments revisit the prediction task and computational structure of direct generation, motivating raw-motion generation that accounts for body structure and temporal continuity.
blocks.zh: 像素-空间传播直接生成图像,而无需学习的可解码器. 早期的传播模型在像素空间中进行了迭代解析,但处理高分辨的图像却产生了巨大的计算成本[11,5]. Lententnt扩散通过将去诺化变成压缩的表示,引入对所学编码器和解码器的依赖[29]来降低成本. 最近的工作是通过适当的预测目标、损失空间和高效的架构[18、40、2]重新审视像素-空间生成。 JiT [18] 将预测目标与损失空间区分开来,显示有速度-空间目标的清洁图像预测使得平面变形器能够模拟高维像素补丁. 建筑开发进一步将全球模型与局部细节合成相分离[40,2]. PixelDiT [40] 将补丁级语义模型与像素变形器(PiT)块结合,用于精细纹饰的像素更新,而互补设计则使用轻量级局部精细[2]. 这些发展动态重新审视了直接生成的预测任务和计算结构,激发了考虑到机体结构和时间连续性的原始运动生成.

blocks.en: 2.2 Text-to-motion generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 文本对移动生成

blocks.en: Text-to-motion models generate human motion sequences that follow textual descriptions. Early diffusion-based methods denoise motion sequences directly in motion space [ 32 , 46 , 47 ] , with clean-motion prediction enabling geometric supervision on the generated sequence [ 32 ] . To reduce generation costs, many approaches adopt compact learned motion representations. Continuous methods perform diffusion or flow matching in an autoencoder’s latent space [ 1 , 17 , 39 ] , while discrete methods combine vector quantization with autoregressive or masked token prediction [ 45 , 8 , 25 , 41 ] . Skeleton-aware latent designs further capture relationships among joints, frames, and words [ 12 ] . Recent work also explores flow matching directly in motion space, with representation-aware noise scaling [ 38 ] . Our RawMo revisits direct motion generation through body-region modeling, frame-level refinement, and high-noise text-motion supervision informed by recent pixel diffusion.
blocks.zh: 文字到运动模型产生遵循文字描述的人类运动序列. 早期以扩散为主的方法将运动序列直接放入运动空间[32,46,47],对所生成的序列进行能进行几何监督的清洁运动预测[32]. 为降低生成成本,许多办法采用了精密的、有知识的动议表述。 连续方法在自动编码器的潜在空间进行扩散或流相匹配[1、17、39],而离散方法则将矢量定量与自递回或被遮住的信号预测[45、8、25、41]结合起来。 Skeleton-aware潜在设计进一步捕捉到关节,帧和词[12]之间的关系. 近期的工作还探索了在运动空间中直接相匹配的流量,并有能体现-有意识的噪声缩放[38]. 我们的RawMo通过身体区域建模、帧级改进和高噪声文本运动监督,通过最近的像素扩散,重新审视直接运动产生。

blocks.en: 2.3 Motion-conditional generation
blocks.zh: 2.3 有条件发电

blocks.en: Motion-conditional generation synthesizes motion under partial observations, such as joint trajectories, keyframes, or selected body parts. Existing approaches use inference-time inpainting or spatial guidance [ 32 , 15 ] , compose diffusion priors for joint-level control [ 30 ] , or use learned control branches [ 37 , 4 ] . Other methods refine structured motion latents through trajectory-based optimization [ 33 ] , while observation-conditioned denoising learns completion from randomly sampled frame and joint observations [ 3 ] . Unified frameworks further combine generation and editing through a common formulation of source motion, conditions, and target motion [ 10 ] . Prior work incorporates partial motion observations during denoising [ 32 ] and uses sampling-time projection to enforce exact linear spatial constraints [ 35 ] . Our RawMo preserves given motion conditions exactly using a single conditional model with a global skip.
blocks.zh: 运动-条件生成在部分观测下会合成运动,如联合出轨,键框,或所选取的机体部分. 现有方法采用推论-时间插图或空间取向[32、15],为联合水平控制编制传播前科[30],或使用所学控制分支[37、4]。 其他方法通过以轨迹为基础的优化来完善结构化运动潜质[33],而以观察为条件的去诺化则从随机抽样的框架和联合观测中学习完成[3]. 统一框架通过源运动、条件和目标运动的共同表述进一步结合生成和编辑[10]。 先前的工作包括了去Noting [32] 期间的部分运动观测,并使用采样时间投影来强制实施精确的线性空间约束[35]. 我们的 RawMo 保留了给定的运动条件 完全使用一个带有全局跳跃的单一条件模型 。

blocks.en: To assess the feasibility of transferring pixel-space diffusion principles to motion, we conduct a preliminary study in raw motion space. JiT [ 18 ] motivates our study by showing that a plain Transformer can generate high-quality images directly from raw patches without a learned codec.

blocks.en: Building on the findings in Sec. 3 , RawMo generates text-conditioned motion directly in raw motion space using clean-motion prediction and a velocity-space objective. Fig. 3 provides an overview of RawMo. The Motion Diffusion Transformer (MiT) combines body-region and frame representations in a text-conditioned backbone, followed by joint-level reconstruction through a refinement head (Sec. 4.1 ). HiNCE provides text-alignment supervision for clean-motion predictions at high-noise timesteps (Sec. 4.2 ). A global skip preserves given motion conditions exactly in each clean-motion prediction (Sec. 4.3 ).

blocks.en: 4.2 Text Alignment at High Noise
blocks.zh: 4.2 高噪声时的文本对齐

blocks.en: We use our high-noise text-motion alignment loss (HiNCE) to improve the text consistency of clean-motion predictions. Before MiT training, we jointly pretrain a motion encoder ℰ M \mathcal{E}_{M} and a text encoder ℰ T \mathcal{E}_{T} on paired training data. Through a CLIP-style InfoNCE objective [ 28 , 22 ] , the two encoders learn a shared embedding space for measuring how well a motion expresses its caption. Fig. 3 (top left) illustrates this pretraining stage.
blocks.zh: 我们使用高噪声的文本-运动对齐损失(HinCE)来提高干净运动预测的文本一致性. 在MiT训练前,我们联合在对等的训练数据上预排了运动编码器E M\ mathcal{E}_{M}和文字编码器E T\mathcal{E}_{T}. 通过一个CLIP风格的InfoNCE目标[28,22],两个编码器学习一个共享嵌入空间来测量运动表达其标题的好坏. 图3(左上方)说明了这一培训前阶段的情况。

blocks.en: During MiT training, ℰ M \mathcal{E}_{M} and ℰ T \mathcal{E}_{T} remain frozen and serve as a fixed semantic reference for HiNCE. Working in raw motion space allows HiNCE to supervise clean-motion predictions directly, passing semantic feedback to MiT without an intermediate motion decoder.
blocks.zh: 在MiT训练期间,E M\mathcal{E}_{M}和E T\mathcal{E}_{T}仍然被冻结并用作HINCE的固定语义参考. 在原始运动空间工作使得HINCE可以直接监督清洁运动预测,在没有中间运动解码器的情况下将语义反馈传递给MiT.

blocks.en: 5.1 Datasets and Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 5.1 数据集和评价计量

blocks.en: Datasets. We evaluate RawMo on HumanML3D [ 9 ] and KIT Motion-Language (KIT-ML) [ 27 ] . HumanML3D contains 14,616 motion sequences and 44,970 descriptions (22 joints, 20 fps), while KIT-ML contains 3,911 sequences and 6,278 descriptions (21 joints, 12.5 fps). We follow the standard training, validation, and test splits [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们评价RawMo在HumanML3D[9]和KIT Motion-Language(KIT-ML)[27]. HumanML3D包含有14,616个运动序列和44,970个描述(22个关节,20个英尺),而KIT-ML包含有3,911个序列和6,278个描述(21个关节,12.5个英尺). 我们遵循标准训练,验证,测试分拆[9].

blocks.en: Text-to-motion evaluation. We report R-Precision (R@1/2/3) for text-motion retrieval, Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) for comparing generated and real motion distributions, and Multimodal Distance (MMDist) for the average embedding distance between paired motions and captions. On HumanML3D, we use both the standard 263-D evaluator of Guo et al . [ 9 ] and the 67-D evaluator introduced by MARDM [ 21 ] . The latter retains root motion and local joint positions. We use both evaluators to verify our performance across different motion representations. KIT-ML uses only the 251-D evaluator of Guo et al .
blocks.zh: 文字对动评价. 我们报告R-精密度(R@1/2/3)用于文本-运动检索,Fréchet Inception District(FID)用于比较生成的和真实的运动分布,而MMDist用于组合运动和标题之间的平均嵌入距离。 在HumanML3D上,我们既使用了郭等的标准263-D评价器[9],也使用了MARDM介绍的67-D评价器[21]. 后者保留了根运动和地方共同立场。 我们利用两位评价员核查我们在不同动议陈述中的表现。 KIT-ML只使用郭等的251-D评价器.

blocks.en: We train our models from scratch on the training split for 30k steps on HumanML3D and 20k on KIT-ML, using a batch size of 128 on one NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPU. We use a 12-block Transformer backbone (width 384, 6 heads) and a 2-block refinement head. The conditional model follows the HumanML3D settings without HiNCE, taking observations as extra input. blocks.en: Baselines. Baselines cover inference-time control using motion priors [ 32 , 30 , 15 ] , learned control mechanisms [ 37 , 4 ] , and optimization or projection for constraint enforcement [ 33 , 35 ] , alongside recent motion-control frameworks [ 34 , 24 , 20 ] .

blocks.en: Pelvis control. Pelvis control requires the generated full-body motion to follow pelvis positions specified at selected frames. We preserve height with the global skip and adjust root velocities during sampling to match horizontal targets (see Appendix ). Table 4 reports results on HumanML3D following the protocol of OmniControl [ 37 ] , using a single conditional RawMo model across all observation densities. RawMo achieves 0 Traj., 0 Loc., and 0 Err. , demonstrating exact preservation of the specified pelvis positions. Compared with MaskControl [ 24 ] under the 263-D evaluator of Guo et al . These results demonstrate exact spatial control alongside improved motion quality and text alignment under both evaluators. Fig. 4 shows qualitative results of our RawMo on text-to-motion generation and diverse motion-conditioning tasks.

blocks.en: Motion modeling. Removing the refinement head worsens FID 67 \mathrm{FID}_{67} from 0.028 to 0.060 and MMDist from 2.481 to 2.513. These degradations support our refinement head’s role in coordinating reconstruction across frames. Removing either body-region or frame tokens also worsens FID under both evaluators. Fig. 5 (a) shows the sources of frame-token attention outputs by block. Early dual-stream blocks mainly use frame and region information, with text contributions increasing in later dual-stream blocks. In the single-stream stage, frame contributions rise again, and the final frame features provide context for the refinement head. These features already carry region and text information from earlier blocks, so lower direct text contributions do not necessarily indicate weaker text influence.
blocks.zh: 运动模特. 取出精制头使FID 67\mathrm{FID}_{67}从0.028到0.060,MMDist从2.481到2.513. 这些退化支持了我们的完善领导在协调跨框架重建方面的作用。 在两个评价者看来,取消机构-区域或框架标志也使识别指数恶化。 图5(a)按区块显示帧式关注产出的来源。 早期的双流区块主要使用帧和区域信息,而后期的双流区块中文本贡献不断增加. 在单流阶段,框架贡献再次上升,而最终框架特征为完善头提供了背景. 这些特征已经携带了从更早的区块得到的区域和文本信息,因此更低的直接文本贡献并不一定表明文本影响更弱.

blocks.en: HiNCE. Without HiNCE, R@1 drops from 0.615 to 0.583 and MMDist worsens from 2.481 to 2.605. Extending supervision from our high-noise range ( τ ≤ 0.25 \tau\leq 0.25 ) to all timesteps ( τ ≤ 1.0 \tau\leq 1.0 ) improves R@1 to 0.620 and MMDist to 2.467, but worsens FID from 0.028 to 0.049 under the 67-D evaluator, showing a trade-off between text alignment and motion quality. blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented RawMo , bringing text-to-motion generation back to raw motion . MiT captures skeletal structure and temporal dynamics, while HiNCE improves text alignment through clean-motion supervision at high noise. Experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML demonstrate the potential of direct raw-motion generation for high-quality, text-consistent motion with exact condition preservation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了RawMo, 将文字到动作的生成带回原始运动。 MiT捕捉出骨骼结构和时间动态,而HINCE则通过高噪声下清洁运动监督来改进文本的对齐. 关于HumanML3D和KIT-ML的实验显示,直接生动产生具有精确保存条件的高质量和文本相容运动的潜力.

This representation has D = 12 ​ J − 1 D=12J-1 channels per frame: 263 for HumanML3D with J = 22 J=22 and 251 for KIT-ML with J = 21 J=21 . We standardize each channel using training-split statistics. Root heading and planar position are recovered by integrating the root velocities.

blocks.en: Network architecture. Table 12 summarizes the architecture, training, and sampling settings. The backbone ℬ θ \mathcal{B}_{\theta} uses dual-stream and single-stream blocks with an MLP ratio of 4, temporal RoPE [ 31 ] , sigmoid gating on attention outputs, and RMSNorm before and after each branch. The global conditioning vector modulates each block through adaptive normalization. Each body-region token pools three to five joints over four frames and receives a learned region embedding. The 12 regions cover the pelvis, spine, chest, head, and bilateral hips, legs, shoulders, and arms. Adjacent regions share a junction joint. Each frame token is formed by projecting all D D features through a rank-128 bottleneck. In each refinement block, the J × 32 J\times 32 joint features of each frame are compressed into a 384-D vector. Four-head temporal attention with RoPE mixes these vectors across frames. The block then expands the resulting vectors back into joint features and applies a joint-wise MLP. A frozen CLIP ViT-B/32 [ 28 ] encodes the text prompt. All text-to-motion results use dedicated T2M models, while all motion-conditioned results use a single conditional RawMo model. The conditional model is trained on HumanML3D without HiNCE.

blocks.en: HiNCE implementation. HiNCE uses a motion encoder and a text encoder. The motion encoder projects standardized motion features to 256 dimensions, reduces temporal resolution by a factor of four using two strided 1-D convolutions, and applies a four-layer, four-head Transformer. The text encoder applies a two-layer Transformer to frozen CLIP token features. Both encoders use mean pooling and output unit-normalized 512-D embeddings.
blocks.zh: 实施HINCE。 HINCE使用运动编码器和文本编码器. 运动编码器项目将运动特性标准化到256个维度,利用两个被扭曲的1-D分解而将时间分辨率降低为4倍,并应用了四层四头变形器. 文本编码器对被冻结的CLIP符号特性应用了双层变形器. 两种编码器都使用平均集合和输出单位常态化的512-D嵌入.

blocks.en: We jointly train the encoders with symmetric InfoNCE [ 22 ] and a learned temperature initialized to 0.07. Training uses a batch size of 256 and a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , with 1,000 warm-up steps followed by cosine decay. The training budget is 12k steps on HumanML3D and 6k on KIT-ML. Checkpoints are selected by validation R@3, choosing step 3k for HumanML3D and step 1k for KIT-ML. Following TMR [ 23 ] , we mask near-duplicate negatives when the cosine similarity between the CLIP end-of-text features of the negative and positive captions exceeds 0.9. During text-to-motion generator training, both encoders remain frozen. The HiNCE loss is applied at high-noise timesteps τ ≤ 0.25 \tau\leq 0.25 , excluding queries with dropped text prompts and masking the same near-duplicate negatives. To account for the motion encoder’s temporal stride, we average the losses for the four input offsets 0 , 1 , 2 , 3 0,1,2,3 .

blocks.en: Motion-conditioning inputs. The conditional model receives the given motion features 𝐱 c \mathbf{x}_{c} , their feature mask 𝐦 \mathbf{m} , and six root-conditioning channels. The six root-conditioning channels comprise two position channels, two heading channels, and two availability masks. The position channels encode the root’s horizontal position in global coordinates as ( x , z ) / ( 2 ​ m ) (x,z)/(2\,\mathrm{m}) . The heading channels encode the root heading angle θ \theta as ( cos ⁡ θ , sin ⁡ θ ) (\cos\theta,\sin\theta) . One availability mask indicates whether the root position is given, and the other indicates whether the root heading is given. Zero-initialized linear projections inject these conditions into the joint features used for region pooling, the frame tokens, and the raw joint tokens.

We denote the corrected horizontal displacement from frame t t to t + 1 t+1 in global coordinates by Δ ​ 𝐩 ~ t \Delta\widetilde{\mathbf{p}}_{t} . The i i -th controlled frame in temporal order has frame index k i k_{i} and given horizontal position 𝐩 k i \mathbf{p}_{k_{i}} . blocks.en: Zero-shot motion control. RawMo performs motion control using a conditional model trained separately from the dedicated text-to-motion model. Enabling the text-to-motion model to follow motion conditions without additional training remains an open problem.

blocks.en: Sampling latency. RawMo generates motion through iterative denoising. As reported in Table 11 , generating a single HumanML3D clip on an NVIDIA RTX 4090 takes a median of 0.594 s. Future work could focus on reducing the number of sampling steps while preserving motion quality, with the goal of lowering generation latency and improving responsiveness in interactive applications.
